title: model
content_html:
model

The kylie wax model series and the imperfect lens imagined in 10,000 offer different ways to approach a model. It can be an object made to study another thing, a possible world built to see what happens inside it or a simplification that lets a relation come into view. Handling wax, looking at a picture and changing an assumption in a mathematical model each make different discoveries possible. When do the conveniences of a model start to look like properties of the thing it was made to explain? A model of consciousness raises a related question. Can it account for how a mind comes to ask questions of its own? Kylie wax model 1.0 · 10,000

Reading note. Buddhism. In the Alagaddūpama Sutta, a raft is useful because it gets someone across and can be left after the crossing. The lens in 10,000 raises a similar question about the life of a tool. What has a model made possible, and at what point might carrying it into the next enquiry get in the way? Alagaddūpama Sutta, MN 22
